english.title: Attempt to make off without making payment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that payment on the spot for

(A)_[goods supplied,]_
(B)_[a service done,]_
(C)_[services done,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS OR SERVICES..), was required or expected from you, dishonestly attempted to make off without having paid as required or expected and with intent to avoid payment of **(..SPECIFY THE AMOUNT DUE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowing a payment on the spot
required/expected for goods supplied/services done dishonestly attempted to make off
without having paid as required/expected with intent to avoid payment

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Ymgais i fynd ymaith heb dalu
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), gan wybod y byddai'n rhaid i chi dalu neu ei bod yn ddisgwyliedig y byddech yn talu yn y fan a'r lle am

(A)_[nwyddau a gyflenwyd,]_
(B)_[wasanaeth a gyflawnwyd,]_
(C)_[wasanaethau a gyflawnwyd,]_

sef **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS OR SERVICES..), bu i chi yn anonest geisio mynd ymaith heb dalu fel yr oedd yn ofynnol neu'n ddisgwyliedig a chan fwriadu osgoi talu **(..SPECIFY THE AMOUNT DUE..)
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 1(1) o Ddeddf Ymgeisiau i Droseddu 1981

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
